subject.title: feat(runner): support OpenClaw plugins across the ClawHub profile

question: Should ClawScan's public CLI support OpenClaw plugins as a first-class `plugin` target, including JSON5 manifest compatibility and per-scanner target-kind capability declarations?
rationale: This is a new user-visible target kind and adapter contract rather than a repair to an established ClawScan behavior; technical tests cannot determine whether that public scope belongs in the general-purpose CLI.

options.title: Sponsor the plugin target contract
options.body: Accept plugin targets as a supported ClawScan surface and merge after normal code-owner review of the compatibility and dependency boundary.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Keep plugin scanning out of the public runner until maintainers define a smaller supported scanner/profile scope and manifest compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the plugin target contract
recommendation.body: Accept plugin targets as a supported ClawScan surface and merge after normal code-owner review of the compatibility and dependency boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the PR's requested code owner for the affected runner and CLI surface.
